title: Aspen Search line reveal text
description: Text that reveals line by line as it scrolls into view: each line rises out of a clip and fades in, lines lower down following a beat later. Display mode lets big words travel further.
notes: CSS only: every word is a clip box on its own view timeline, so words sharing a line move together
static HTML and browsers without scroll-driven animations show the text in place; off under reduced motion
name: aspensearch-reveal-text

props.name: text
props.description: the text; it is split into words, and the words of one line rise together as that line scrolls into view

props.name: variant
props.description: copy: lines rise from their own height over a short scroll · display: big words rise further and slower

props.name: delay
props.description: pushes the start of the reveal later, in % of the scroll range (staggers stacked display lines)
